in_marathi.name: Indulekha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Jewel in the hollow of the eye
in_marathi.long_meaning: Indulekha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Indulekha is derived from Sanskrit. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a girl. The name Indulekha can be broken down into two parts. Indu means 'jewel' and lekha means 'hollow of the eye'. The name Indulekha thus signifies 'jewel in the hollow of the eye'. This name is believed to be auspicious and is often given to girls who are believed to be the embodiment of beauty, grace, and intelligence. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Parvati is known to keep the moon in the hollow of her eye. This name is also believed to bestow upon the child the qualities of Parvati, such as beauty, grace, and intelligence.
